title: boot.json (v1)
description: Boot marker written by app:boot (spec §9.5). Requests answer 503 when it is missing or differs from the loaded configuration.

config_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the effective configuration (without secret).

secret_check.description: HMAC-SHA-256 of "sp-proto/v1/server/secret-check" under a key derived from the instance secret; not reversible.
